scope: All 13 final page-2 candidates in MuPDF-rendered PDF contact sheets; a seven-page X-s43 contact sheet; post-render OCR for all 13 candidates.
findings: All inspected page-2 headings, paragraphs, bullets and lower-page content remain present and legible at contact-sheet resolution. No clipping, overlap or missing blocks observed.
Optimized pages show faint background texture; this is not evidence of perceptual invisibility.
Full-document page order and seven-page layout are retained. Exact pixel checks establish preservation of the other six pages for every candidate.
limitations: Visual inspection is not a blinded human readability study.
Pixel constraints apply before rendering; Poppler conversion changes are measured separately.
The original native PDF was not edited. Experimental output PDFs are raster derivatives and lose native text semantics.
